answer:
Use N-mm-MPa consistent units throughout the calculation.
Assume Euler-Bernoulli beam theory with small deflection and linear elastic material behavior.
Model a cantilever beam of length L = 1800 mm, fixed at x = 0 and free at x = L.
Use structural steel modulus of elasticity E = 200000 MPa.
Use constant second moment of area I = 1200000 mm^4.
Apply a downward point load P = 2000 N at the free end (x = L).
The bending moment along the beam is M(x) = -P(L - x), varying linearly from -PL at the fixed end to 0 at the free end.
Compute the slope at the free end using theta = PL^2 / (2EI), and report the result in radians (and optionally in degrees).
Compute the vertical deflection at the free end using delta = PL^3 / (3EI), and report the result in mm.
Present both final numerical answers clearly with appropriate units.
